East Point Medical College overview: East Point Medical College Bangalore is a part of the jnana Prabha campus and houses an educational institution. It was established by DR S M Venkatapathi. It was established in 2017. College is affiliated to RAJIV GANDHI UNIVERSITY OF HEALTH SCIENCEs. Mission of the college is to bring the quality health care including underprivileged people and so give the best educational quality and stress free period for the students
Key Highlights: East Point Medical College Bangalore is affiliated to Rajiv Gandhi University of Health Science ,Bangalore .and was approved by medical council of India. It was established in 1996 by government of Karnataka and nearly 3000 colleges affiliated. The college is under Jnana Prabha campus educational institution .the other colleges that comes under are
East point college of engineering and technology.
East point PU college and schools.

East Point college has its own partner hospital on the campus of the college . students get to learn and treat patients after a certain time in the guidance of seniors and faculty staff .East Point campus is quite a large campus with hospital ,college , hostel and playgrounds .College is in the outskirts of Bangalore away from the traffic noise. College is around so many villages which brings in a lot of casualties to the hospital.
Why study at East Point medical college?: College is in the outskirts of the city area but it is a blessing for medical students for good study and focus. Although college is recently established but college has such good results and good reviews in a short period of time.

Course structure – All the courses in the college run by appropriate curriculum given by the university to the college. College curriculum is designed in a such way that student can learn both practicals and teaching faculty are professional and modern learning equipment

Infrastructure – College has a large campus with lush greenery and large playgrounds for walks . College ,hospital ,mess and hostel situated in the same campus makes student life a lot easier and saves students a lot of money and time.

Hospital – Where a lot of other colleges have tried with other hospitals for students to learn, East point medical college has its own hospital .Hospital has so many beds where you can practice medicine everyday under the guidance of staff. Well this is the reason you should consider joining the east point college. The hospital brings a lot of patients and the better the patient flow the better the learning.

College ethics and committees – College has set a few facility members in the committees to look after a few issues like ragging, eg – anti -ragging committee will take strict actions and preventive measures to avoid ragging. Student counselor will look into issue student faces in the college and work on solution. This college really stands on their mission.
MBBS: East Point Medical College Bangalore offers only one course in this campus i.e., MBBS. The college has other campuses for other courses like nursing ,business and many others mentioned above. MBBS is a undergraduate degree. one can join MBBS after 12th and one can proceed MD after MBBS
MBBS is total 5 and half year course that is – Four and half years

One year internship – Internship program is also a compulsory part of MBBS . It is a period in MBBS where you work as a doctor in the hospital . interns in the hospitals are more exposed to the patient and work in hospitals with minimum salary. Internships can be done in the hospital of your choice .eg – in case you don’t want to continue in east point medical college you can ask for transfer in the college of your choice .
Departments: Anatomy

The Anatomy department of the college has various collections of species and human body parts like ( brain ,lungs ,tongue ,face etc.) for study purposes . In fact , this is the first thing you do after joining college in the first year . department also has skulls and bones of the body ,charts and models for better learning . department also have microscopes and histology slides.
Physiology

Physiology is one of the first three practical in MBBS(first year)and physiology is a branch of biology that deals with normal functions of the human body and life, basic things that you will need for life will thought in this lab like measurement of blood pressure ,pulse rate, hematology test. lab of physiology in east point medical college is well equipped and four practical halls just for physiology with modern microscopes and equipment for practical.
Biochemistry

Biochemistry is a science that deals with chemical and physio-chemical processes and substances that occur within living organisms. teachers in biochemistry lab will teach you about chemicals and experiments like differential tests for blood sugars ,chemical examination of normal urine, test for jaundice( liver function test). Lab in east point medical college is huge and has a single hall which can accommodate 100 students. Lab is facilitated with all the equipment and audio – visual smart screens.
Pathology

Pathology is a branch of science that deals with study of disease and diagnosis through removed tissue. lab in east point medical college of pathology is equipped with modern diagnostic aids for investigations and hematology instruments. department has a museum that has a collection of various number of spices of diseased organs and chart and models for better understanding. Pathology lab also has around 100 microscopes for studying slides.
Microbiology
Microbiology is a branch of science that deals with study of microorganisms and morphology of the microorganisms. lab has one single hall that can accommodate 75 students staining.
Pharmacology

Pharmacology is a branch of medical science that deals with the study of drugs and its mechanism. Pharmacology is one of the interesting practicals of MBBS. Lab is totally equipped for drug preparation. Equipment used in college are verified and safe.
Forensic Medicine

The department teaches the legal aspect of medical practice to students that helps in resolution of criminal cases on the basis of scientific facts. The department has access to laboratories and seminar rooms. For forensic study the lab is facilitated with microscope ,x-ray machines. Age estimation is learnt by x -rays and the main aspect that help in study of the criminal case is dentition of the criminal ,bite marks and lip bite. tooth molds and OPG are given for studies. Department also has a museum that has a collection of various bones, forensic cases and photographs, snake specimens and different types of weapons.
Community Medicine

Community medicine department is all about serving the rural population by offering them medical service. The department of east point medical college conducts at least two camps every week .The department is equipped with smart TVs for displaying content in the form of videos and pictures for better understanding of students and patients. Department also has computers for statistical cells, community medicine has a number of charts ,posters and survey cases for better understanding about health issues and hygiene importance and educating patients for the same.

Admissions in East Point Medical College: Getting admission to a good medical college is not easy and there are many aspirants who apply to this college. Out of those many, East Point medical college Bangalore picks out 150 deserving candidates for MBBS course. So, let’s start with the admission intake followed by the procedure and eligibility to get admission to East Point medical college . If you are seeking information on the admission process of the karnataka medical colleges, you can check out our article on MBBS Admission in Karnataka .
or if you want to refer the information about the admission process and other useful details regarding bangalore medical colleges, refer to our article called MBBS admission in bangalore .
Admission intake: Below is a list of the total seat availability for each course at East Point Medical College Bangalore.
Admission process: If you are interested in admission into East Point medical college Bangalore, there are certain steps and procedures, and they include:
Step 1: Appear for the Entrance Exam: NEET UG is the necessary admission requirement for the MBBS program. Students interested in seeking admission into East Point medical college, must qualify for the undergraduate entrance exam.
Step 2: Register for State NEET Counsell: All those who qualified from the entrance exams can now register for the Karnataka NEET UG counselling. The Karnataka Examinations Authority (KEA) conducts the state counselling. You can visit Karnataka MBBS admission for further information.
Step 3: Seat Allotment: Once the seat allotment list is published, selected applicants should report to the respective college.
Step 4: Document Verification: Candidates have to proceed toward verifying their respective documents.
Step 5: Required Fee Payment: Selected students ought to make the required fee payment to confirm admission.
Entrance examination: East Point Medical College Bangalore doesn’t conduct their own entrance examination for the admissions , although there few state and national entrance examination one has to pass or qualify for admission examination like NEET ( national eligibility cum entrance test).
Eligibility Criteria: Candidates must have passed 12th standard / PUC from board or council.
Candidates should have passed 12th standard in PCMB subjects (physics, chemistry ,mathematics and biology).
Candidates must have qualify NEET entrance examination with at least 50 percent marks.
Must have completed seventeen years of age as on 31st December as on the year of admission.
Candidates must have all required documents mentioned below.
Documents Required: 6 Recent Passport Size photos
Downloaded copy of KEA/CET/NEET admission order

Original Transfer Certificate
Clear Xerox copy of caste certificate (SC/ST/OBC)
Clear Xerox copy of Student & Parents Aadhar Card
Clear Xerox copy of 10th and 12th Marks Card
NEET Admission Ticket
NEET Result Sheet and Score card
KEA Fees Paid Challan
Original Study Certificate
Rural bond Annexure – 1 and Annexure – 9 (on stamp paper duly notarized)
Clear Xerox copy of Student/Parent PAN card
Eligibility Certificate from RGUHS for Non-Karnataka Board in 12th Std

MD/MS Fees: Scholarships – college helps the student with scholarships every year for those who have top scored in an academic year and NSS also provide scholarships for some category every year.

Educational loans – The institution arranges for the loan from various nationalized and private banks, you can avail this facility by and talking to bank manager and administrative office at college. Educational loans needs support of parents and signature and college has to provide a letter and fee structure to the respective bank and you will have to submit your passing marks card of previous year for loan every year.

Placements – East Point Medical College does not promise you placements after completion of MBBS for that matter no MBBS college promises or help you for placements but college helps for internship. Internship is the most important period of MBBS life in this period. East Point medical college has its own hospital for internship.
East Point Hospital & Services: Hospital is located on the campus of East Point Medical College Bangalore. since this college belongs to the college . staff of the college are doctors in the hospital and interns work under the staff .staff and interns (residents) help the students. The hospital has all the facilities for students and patients.
Emergency service: Emergency department works 24×7 with OPD which is also attached to 10 labor beds and 10 emergency beds equipped with oxygen supply , oximeter, crash carts ,monitors and minor operation theaters
OPD (outpatient department): All departments like general medicine ,general surgery, ENT, derma, ophthalmology ,dental, psychiatry have their own OPD service and there is also general OPD from where patient are sent to respective departments and there are 24 beds distribution among these departments
Diagnostic facilities: All the diagnostic services are available at a single laboratory.it has all three departments attached to it microbiology, pathology and biochemistry. Laboratory is totally modernized and provides accurate results in short period and open 24 x7
Radiology: Department of radiology has 2 portable x ray machines frequency ranging from 300mA,600mA, and 800mA.Also has ultrasound machines and CT Scan
ICU (intensive care unit): ICU has total 35 beds in number and also works 24 x 7 with physicians and intensivists, bedside nurses and anesthesiologists is particularized and specified with all equipment, especially ventilators.

Other departments – The college has all the departments like blood bank ,pharmacy, operation theaters, gynecology, ambulance service, department of dentistry. Departments are fully facilitated and punctual providing great service to patients and humanity.
On-Campus Facilities Offered: ➤ campus – East Point Medical college has vast campus area.it is located in the outskirts of city ,surrounded by green and campus is spacious, parking facilities are available in campus only, environment is very pleasant especially studying which keep students fresh.

➤ classrooms – The college has 4 theaters with light and ventilation. Classrooms have centralized air conditioners ,smart class, white and green board, metallic chairs and table. There are separate demo classes in every department with basic white boards and chairs.

➤ laboratories – The college has separate labs for separate departments which are also very ventilated and hygienic. All the safety measures have been taken in construction and maintenance .There are well equipped and students are provided with all the materials for experiments and practical.
➤ Auditoriums – Very spacious , can accommodate more than 400 people , college conducts various events here such as graduation ,intra and inter college fest ,freshers and small celebrations.

➤ Cafeteria and Canteen – The college has a cafeteria which is small that serves hot and cold beverages for a reasonable price .It also has snacks like maggie, samosa ,chips and ice creams.c anteen serves meals and breakfast which is fixed price and fixed menu.

➤ Playground – The college has not too big but it is quite a playground on campus. you can play a sport of your choice in the playground. Volleyball, throwball, football nets are available. people enjoy playing cricket here mostly. sports events are conducted in the playground every year.

➤ Hostels – The college has two separate hostels for boys and girls. Both hostels can accommodate about 200-300 students. Hostel has two sharing ,three sharing rooms according to convenience .Hostel has all basic facilities like hot water ,table and chairs ,hygiene washrooms, laundry services ,separate dining area ,separate tv room ,wi-fi and internet service.
➤ Community health camps – Health camps are conducted twice a week from college. where residents visit satellite areas and treat patients also educate patients of rural areas.
➤ Events in college – The college encourage and conduct so many events every year ,fest are conducted every year to encourage student talent and sports.

➤ Library – college library is well organized ,spacious and ventilated .It has a collection of all the authors books of national and international authors. Books are sufficient in number. library has 3 divisions one is study hall , one is not air conditioned area and the other air conditioned area .Library operates from morning 8am to 10pm . It also have a collection of journals ,magazines ,question papers and news papers.
➤ Digital library – college has a digital library attached to central library. Digital library has computers and fast internet they also have CDs, and xerox machine for print.

East Point Medical College overview: East Point Medical College Bangalore is a part of the jnana Prabha campus and houses an educational institution. It was established by DR S M Venkatapathi. It was established in 2017. College is affiliated to RAJIV GANDHI UNIVERSITY OF HEALTH SCIENCEs. Mission of the college is to bring the quality health care including underprivileged people and so give the best educational quality and stress free period for the students
Key Highlights: East Point Medical College Bangalore is affiliated to Rajiv Gandhi University of Health Science ,Bangalore .and was approved by medical council of India. It was established in 1996 by government of Karnataka and nearly 3000 colleges affiliated. The college is under Jnana Prabha campus educational institution .the other colleges that comes under are
East point college of engineering and technology.
East point PU college and schools.

East Point college has its own partner hospital on the campus of the college . students get to learn and treat patients after a certain time in the guidance of seniors and faculty staff .East Point campus is quite a large campus with hospital ,college , hostel and playgrounds .College is in the outskirts of Bangalore away from the traffic noise. College is around so many villages which brings in a lot of casualties to the hospital.
Why study at East Point medical college?: College is in the outskirts of the city area but it is a blessing for medical students for good study and focus. Although college is recently established but college has such good results and good reviews in a short period of time.

Course structure – All the courses in the college run by appropriate curriculum given by the university to the college. College curriculum is designed in a such way that student can learn both practicals and teaching faculty are professional and modern learning equipment

Infrastructure – College has a large campus with lush greenery and large playgrounds for walks . College ,hospital ,mess and hostel situated in the same campus makes student life a lot easier and saves students a lot of money and time.

Hospital – Where a lot of other colleges have tried with other hospitals for students to learn, East point medical college has its own hospital .Hospital has so many beds where you can practice medicine everyday under the guidance of staff. Well this is the reason you should consider joining the east point college. The hospital brings a lot of patients and the better the patient flow the better the learning.

College ethics and committees – College has set a few facility members in the committees to look after a few issues like ragging, eg – anti -ragging committee will take strict actions and preventive measures to avoid ragging. Student counselor will look into issue student faces in the college and work on solution. This college really stands on their mission.
MBBS: East Point Medical College Bangalore offers only one course in this campus i.e., MBBS. The college has other campuses for other courses like nursing ,business and many others mentioned above. MBBS is a undergraduate degree. one can join MBBS after 12th and one can proceed MD after MBBS
MBBS is total 5 and half year course that is – Four and half years

One year internship – Internship program is also a compulsory part of MBBS . It is a period in MBBS where you work as a doctor in the hospital . interns in the hospitals are more exposed to the patient and work in hospitals with minimum salary. Internships can be done in the hospital of your choice .eg – in case you don’t want to continue in east point medical college you can ask for transfer in the college of your choice .
Departments: Anatomy

The Anatomy department of the college has various collections of species and human body parts like ( brain ,lungs ,tongue ,face etc.) for study purposes . In fact , this is the first thing you do after joining college in the first year . department also has skulls and bones of the body ,charts and models for better learning . department also have microscopes and histology slides.
Physiology

Physiology is one of the first three practical in MBBS(first year)and physiology is a branch of biology that deals with normal functions of the human body and life, basic things that you will need for life will thought in this lab like measurement of blood pressure ,pulse rate, hematology test. lab of physiology in east point medical college is well equipped and four practical halls just for physiology with modern microscopes and equipment for practical.
Biochemistry

Biochemistry is a science that deals with chemical and physio-chemical processes and substances that occur within living organisms. teachers in biochemistry lab will teach you about chemicals and experiments like differential tests for blood sugars ,chemical examination of normal urine, test for jaundice( liver function test). Lab in east point medical college is huge and has a single hall which can accommodate 100 students. Lab is facilitated with all the equipment and audio – visual smart screens.
Pathology

Pathology is a branch of science that deals with study of disease and diagnosis through removed tissue. lab in east point medical college of pathology is equipped with modern diagnostic aids for investigations and hematology instruments. department has a museum that has a collection of various number of spices of diseased organs and chart and models for better understanding. Pathology lab also has around 100 microscopes for studying slides.
Microbiology
Microbiology is a branch of science that deals with study of microorganisms and morphology of the microorganisms. lab has one single hall that can accommodate 75 students staining.
Pharmacology

Pharmacology is a branch of medical science that deals with the study of drugs and its mechanism. Pharmacology is one of the interesting practicals of MBBS. Lab is totally equipped for drug preparation. Equipment used in college are verified and safe.
Forensic Medicine

The department teaches the legal aspect of medical practice to students that helps in resolution of criminal cases on the basis of scientific facts. The department has access to laboratories and seminar rooms. For forensic study the lab is facilitated with microscope ,x-ray machines. Age estimation is learnt by x -rays and the main aspect that help in study of the criminal case is dentition of the criminal ,bite marks and lip bite. tooth molds and OPG are given for studies. Department also has a museum that has a collection of various bones, forensic cases and photographs, snake specimens and different types of weapons.
Community Medicine

Community medicine department is all about serving the rural population by offering them medical service. The department of east point medical college conducts at least two camps every week .The department is equipped with smart TVs for displaying content in the form of videos and pictures for better understanding of students and patients. Department also has computers for statistical cells, community medicine has a number of charts ,posters and survey cases for better understanding about health issues and hygiene importance and educating patients for the same.
Teaching-Learning Methods: College provides a time table in the beginning of the academic year. Time table is decided by the staff and committee. Various tools are used for better teaching like smart classes, videos and pictures, PPT, various charts and models. Things that makes learning easy are

Admission process: If you are interested in admission into East Point medical college Bangalore, there are certain steps and procedures, and they include:
Step 1: Appear for the Entrance Exam: NEET UG is the necessary admission requirement for the MBBS program. Students interested in seeking admission into East Point medical college, must qualify for the undergraduate entrance exam.
Step 2: Register for State NEET Counsell: All those who qualified from the entrance exams can now register for the Karnataka NEET UG counselling. The Karnataka Examinations Authority (KEA) conducts the state counselling. You can visit Karnataka MBBS admission for further information.
Step 3: Seat Allotment: Once the seat allotment list is published, selected applicants should report to the respective college.
Step 4: Document Verification: Candidates have to proceed toward verifying their respective documents.
Step 5: Required Fee Payment: Selected students ought to make the required fee payment to confirm admission.
Entrance examination: East Point Medical College Bangalore doesn’t conduct their own entrance examination for the admissions , although there few state and national entrance examination one has to pass or qualify for admission examination like NEET ( national eligibility cum entrance test).
Eligibility Criteria: Candidates must have passed 12th standard / PUC from board or council.
Candidates should have passed 12th standard in PCMB subjects (physics, chemistry ,mathematics and biology).
Candidates must have qualify NEET entrance examination with at least 50 percent marks.
Must have completed seventeen years of age as on 31st December as on the year of admission.
